The '''SaintapediaFeedback''' extension adds a floating '''Improve this article''' button to content pages so readers can report a problem without opening an edit form, and gives editors a triage dashboard at '''Special:SaintapediaFeedback''' to work through what arrives. Submissions are a category plus an optional short comment, anonymous by default, protected by {{ll|Extension:ConfirmEdit|ConfirmEdit}} and a per-IP daily rate limit.

It is aimed at wikis whose readers greatly outnumber their editors, where the useful signal — "this is out of date", "this contradicts the infobox" — comes from people who will never edit. A handful of operational preferences can be changed from '''MediaWiki:''' pages without redeploying; access and anti-abuse controls are deliberately LocalSettings.php-only (see [[#User rights|below]]).

Developed for [https://saintapedia.org/ Saintapedia].

== Features ==

* Floating '''Improve this article''' button on content pages; dismissable per browser tab, restorable from the screen-edge tab or '''Tools → Improve this article'''
* Category + free-text submission, anonymous by default, with hCaptcha and a per-hashed-IP daily rate limit
* Editor dashboard: filter by status and category, search, sort, bulk-process, per-article views
* Audit trail of who processed what, plus optional {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}} notifications to a named user list and to page watchers — notifications never carry the raw reader comment, only a link back to the dashboard
* Optional public '''resolutions''' view — curated summaries of what was done, never raw reader comments
* Optional contact-email field, gated behind its own user right separately from dashboard access, with an optional retention job to clear old addresses automatically
* JSON export for offline or LLM-assisted triage, gated behind its own user right
* Three lower-stakes operational settings overridable from '''MediaWiki:''' pages, cached and invalidated on save/delete/move; access, rate limit, and CAPTCHA-required are LocalSettings.php-only
* Fails closed: if captcha is required but unavailable, submissions are rejected rather than let through

== Installation ==

{{ExtensionInstall
|SaintapediaFeedback
|registration=required
|db-update=true
|custom-steps=* Optional: {{ll|Extension:ConfirmEdit|ConfirmEdit}} for captcha, {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}} for notifications. Load both before this extension.
}}

Clone from GitHub:

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
cd extensions/
git clone https://github.com/Saintapedia/SaintapediaFeedback.git SaintapediaFeedback
</syntaxhighlight>

Add to <code>LocalSettings.php</code>:

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
wfLoadExtension( 'SaintapediaFeedback' );
</syntaxhighlight>

The extension creates its own tables (<code>spf_feedback</code>, <code>spf_feedback_log</code>), so '''<code>update.php</code> must be run''' on install and after upgrades.

=== Optional dependencies ===

; {{ll|Extension:ConfirmEdit|ConfirmEdit}}
: Needed for captcha on submissions. In public mode the extension fails closed — if a captcha is required but ConfirmEdit is not loaded or is misconfigured, the submission is rejected. Use '''real''' hCaptcha keys, not test keys.
; {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}}
: Enables notifications to the notify-user list and to watchers of the article. Without Echo, feedback is still recorded; it simply does not notify.

== Configuration ==

=== Modes ===

<code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackMode</code> selects a defaults profile rather than a feature set:

{| class="wikitable"
! Mode !! For !! Captcha !! Rate limit !! Comment length !! Email field !! Dashboard access default
|-
| <code>public</code> (default) || Open reader-facing wikis || Required || 5 / IP / day || 500 chars || Off || sysop
|-
| <code>enterprise</code> || Logged-in intranet wikis || Off || 50 / IP / day || 5000 chars || Available || any named account (option C)
|}

Enterprise mode's dashboard-access default reflects that an intranet wiki
typically has far more trusted logged-in staff than a public wiki's
sysop-only default fits. Set <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups</code>
explicitly to override either mode's default (e.g. keep sysop-only on an
enterprise wiki).

=== Main settings ===

; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackMode</code>
: <code>public</code> or <code>enterprise</code>. Default: <code>public</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackNamespaces</code>
: Namespaces where the widget appears. Default: <code>[ NS_MAIN ]</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackRateLimit</code> / <code>...EnterpriseRateLimit</code>
: Submissions per hashed IP per day, public/enterprise mode respectively. Defaults: <code>5</code> / <code>50</code>. LocalSettings.php only (F-08) — not wiki-page overridable.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackIpHashSecret</code>
: Dedicated secret for the rate-limit IP hash, HMAC'd with a UTC-date bucket so the hash changes daily and can't link a visitor indefinitely (F-07). Empty (default) falls back to <code>$wgSecretKey</code>; set a dedicated value so this hash can be rotated independently. Never put it on a wiki page.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackRequireCaptcha</code>
: <code>null</code> = decide from mode; <code>true</code>/<code>false</code> to force. Default: <code>null</code>. LocalSettings.php only (F-08).
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEnableEmail</code>
: Offer an optional contact-email field. Stores a reader-supplied address in plaintext — see [[#Privacy and security|Privacy and security]]. Default: <code>false</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackContactEmailRetentionDays</code>
: Days after submission before <code>maintenance/ExpireContactEmails.php</code> clears <code>fb_contact_email</code> (sets it NULL; the rest of the row is kept). Default: <code>0</code> (disabled). Only relevant when contact email is/was enabled.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsers</code>
: Usernames to notify via Echo. Default: <code>[]</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackNotifyWatchers</code>
: Also notify watchers of the article. Default: <code>true</code>. Only notifies watchers who already pass the dashboard-access check.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackShowPublicCounts</code>
: Show open/resolved counts to readers. Default: <code>false</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEnableTalkLink</code>
: Offer a Talk-page link on actioned items. Default: <code>true</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups</code>
: Groups granted dashboard access. Empty (default) picks a mode-appropriate default — see the Modes table above. LocalSettings.php only (F-08).
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEmailAccessGroups</code> / <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackExportAccessGroups</code>
: Same, for contact-email visibility and for JSON export — both default to <code>[ 'sysop' ]</code> regardless of mode. LocalSettings.php only. A <code>*</code> token is never honored in <code>EmailAccessGroups</code> — contact email can never be made visible to anonymous/everyone, regardless of configuration (F-08).
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEnableLlm</code>
: Master switch for automated LLM triage. Default: <code>false</code>. Non-dry-run <code>maintenance/ProcessFeedbackLlm.php</code> refuses to post or mark rows processed while this is off, even with a <code>--webhook</code> command-line override.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackLlmWebhook</code> / <code>...Token</code> / <code>...BatchSize</code>
: Optional webhook for LLM-assisted triage. Defaults: <code>''</code>, <code>''</code>, <code>100</code>. The token is a secret — keep it in <code>LocalSettings.php</code> or the environment.

Each remaining <code>MediaWiki:</code> page name (notify-users, show-public-counts, enable-talklink) is itself renameable via the matching <code>*Page</code> variable (for example <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsersPage</code>).

=== User rights ===

The three rights are '''independent'''. Granting dashboard access does not grant the other two.

{| class="wikitable"
! Right !! Default !! Grants
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-view</code> || sysop (public) / any named account (enterprise) || Open the dashboard, process and bulk-action feedback
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-viewemail</code> || sysop || See the optional contact-email field
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-export</code> || sysop || Download the JSON export
|}

The split exists so a wiki can hand triage to a broad editor group while keeping reader contact details and bulk offline downloads with a smaller one.

An '''empty <code>*AccessGroups</code> array is not "nobody"''' — it falls back to the mode-appropriate default (dashboard access) or sysop (email/export). Restricting email or export to nobody takes two steps: revoke the right and point the group list at a dummy token.

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
$wgGroupPermissions['sysop']['saintapediafeedback-viewemail'] = false;
$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEmailAccessGroups = [ 'no-one' ];
</syntaxhighlight>

A block revokes both submission and dashboard access immediately, including for administrators, so no extension-specific ban list is needed.

=== Wiki config (MediaWiki: pages) ===

Three operational preferences — not access or anti-abuse controls — can be overridden from pages in the '''MediaWiki:''' namespace, which core restricts to holders of <code>editinterface</code> (by default sysop and interface-admin). One value per line; blank lines, <code>#</code>/<code>;</code> comment lines, inline <code># comments</code>, and a leading wiki-list <code>*</code> are ignored. Changes take effect on save, delete, or move — there is no cache wait.

'''If a page is missing or empty, the PHP value applies.''' Leave a page uncreated unless you intend to override it.

{| class="wikitable"
! Page !! Format !! Overrides
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-notify-users</code> || one username per line || <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsers</code>
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-show-public-counts</code> || <code>true</code>/<code>false</code> || <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackShowPublicCounts</code>
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-enable-talklink</code> || <code>true</code>/<code>false</code> || <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEnableTalkLink</code>
|}

Boolean pages accept <code>true</code>/<code>yes</code>/<code>on</code>/<code>1</code> and <code>false</code>/<code>no</code>/<code>off</code>/<code>0</code>, case-insensitively; anything else is treated as no override.

'''Access, contact-email visibility, export access, the rate limit, and CAPTCHA-required are deliberately NOT on this list''' (2026-09-10 review, F-08). They used to be wiki-page overridable the same way, but that let anyone holding <code>editinterface</code> weaken anti-abuse or access controls with a wiki edit and no deploy or code review. Set <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups</code>, <code>EmailAccessGroups</code>, <code>ExportAccessGroups</code>, <code>RateLimit</code>/<code>EnterpriseRateLimit</code>, and <code>RequireCaptcha</code> directly in <code>LocalSettings.php</code> instead.

'''Never put a secret on a MediaWiki: page.''' Those pages are world-readable even though editing them is restricted. The hCaptcha secret key, the dedicated IP-hash secret, and the LLM webhook token are deliberately not overridable on-wiki.

== Usage ==

; Readers
: The floating button on an article, or '''Tools → Improve this article'''.
; Editors
: '''Special:SaintapediaFeedback''', or '''Tools → Page feedback''' on an article for that page's items. The default filter is '''New'''.
; Per article
: <code>Special:SaintapediaFeedback/&lt;pageid&gt;</code>
; Per-item history
: <code>Special:SaintapediaFeedback/detail/&lt;id&gt;</code> — full status-transition history, not just the last change.
; Public resolutions
: <code>Special:SaintapediaFeedback/resolutions/&lt;pageid&gt;</code> — curated summaries only.

Submissions from the widget go through the API module <code>action=saintapediafeedback</code>.

== Privacy and security ==

* '''IP addresses are never stored in plaintext.''' Rate limiting uses an HMAC of the address over a dedicated, rotatable secret plus a UTC-date bucket, so the stored hash changes every day and cannot link a visitor indefinitely.
* '''The contact-email field is off by default.''' Enabling it stores a reader-supplied address in plaintext in the database. Decide who should be able to read it before switching it on, and set <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackContactEmailRetentionDays</code> plus schedule <code>maintenance/ExpireContactEmails.php</code> if you want it to age out automatically.
* '''The JSON export contains neither contact emails nor IP hashes.''' Export access and email visibility are separate rights so that bulk download cannot become a way around the email restriction.
* '''Echo notifications never carry the raw reader comment.''' A notification links back to the dashboard; the comment itself is only ever visible there, to someone who currently passes the access check.
* '''Contact-email visibility can never be made public.''' A <code>*</code> token in <code>$wgSaintapediaFeedbackEmailAccessGroups</code> is always ignored, regardless of how it got there.
* '''Captcha-required and the rate limit are security controls''' and, as of this review, are LocalSettings.php-only — not wiki-page overridable, so weakening them requires a deploy and code review, not just a wiki edit.
* '''Captcha fails closed.''' If a captcha is required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is unavailable or misconfigured, submissions are rejected rather than silently accepted.
* A rate limit alone will not stop an attacker rotating IPs or using a VPN — hCaptcha is the real backstop against scripted abuse.
